metadata.article_title: Uniform civil code for the citizens

article.title: Uniform civil code for the citizens
article.content: The State shall endeavour to secure for the citizens a uniform civil code throughout the territory of India.
article.html:
44Uniform civil code for the citizens

Article 44 · Part IV

The State shall endeavour to secure for the citizens a uniform civil code throughout the territory of India.
